title: No Gym Leader Battle — Transitional Chapter
overview: Chapter 17 is a transitional finale chapter closing Act 2. There is no Gym Leader battle in this segment. The player descends Route 46 from Blackthorn City, visits New Bark Town for Prof. Elm's second Johto starter gift and the Waterfall tool, and wraps up the Johto mainland campaign. All team rosters are elevated to Cap 72 in route-travel configuration, carrying forward from Clair's Rising Badge duel in Chapter 16.
